title: device.connectivity-settings.v1
description: A device's effective offline-alert settings (spec 018, D6). Producer: control plane, written to device_outbox whenever a device's effective settings change and claimed through POST /api/internal/devices/outbox/claim (spec 018 pull request 3; pull request 2 sends the same fields in the /state snapshot, internal.control-state.v1). Consumer: runtime devices-control, which applies them to its connectivity tracker. At least once; deduplicate by uuid. Fence: generation (a lower one is ignored, an equal one applied).

generation.description: Per-device settings generation. The runtime ignores a lower generation than the one it holds and applies an equal one (it stays 0 until spec 018 pull request 3 adds settings).

enabled.description: Offline alerts on for the device.

style.description: stays_connected: a death certificate or silence counts. connects_to_report: deaths are ignored and a report clears at once. Always connects_to_report for a device fed by a device adapter (D5).

offline_after_seconds.description: Silence after which the device counts as offline; null is automatic: clamp(ceil_to_minute(3 x reporting interval + poll interval), 900, 604800) (D16).

poll_interval_seconds.description: The running adapter revision's poll interval, or null when the device is not polled.

grace_seconds.description: How long the device must stay offline before an episode opens, and back before it clears.

lease_token.description: The outbox claim's lease, present when claimed.
